summary: PR A of #309/#310 (personality-wave-25): the Battle Phase timing primitives the rules lead specified, plus Daidoji Yuki, Experienced (oracle-l5r-1696, scan-verified). Engage window (spec 4.2): opens at selectBattle whenever either player has a legal Engage action / After-engaging Reaction (otherwise the pre-existing flow and event stream), turn player first, alternating, reactions resolve immediately, two passes close it, only Engage/after-engaging Reactions playable inside (MatchEngine.OpenEngageWindow/CloseEngageWindow in the new BattleTiming.cs, PendingChoice engageReaction, MatchState.PendingEngage). First-action claim (4.3/4.4): ClaimFirstOpportunity/ResolveFirstOpportunity decide once at close -- the Defender's claim wins whatever the order, an Attacker's never stacks, none keeps the Defender-first default; public reason Default/Naval/EngageGrant/DefenderOverride. Yuki: Recon Reaction (Trigger after-engaging-at-own-battlefield, new general AbilityDefinition.ActionKeywords tag [Recon]), all-Scouts requirement, assigned-to-the-engaged-battlefield, claim; Reconnaissance is granted to an Attacker's Yuki and is a documented no-op for a Defender's (engine rule: Reconnaissance only at an enemy province) -- flagged, not forced. Naval Invasion (documented in the rules reference) implemented as the naval-invasion player ability: strictly more Naval cards, once per battle, first action bound to its Naval Personality (FirstActionRestriction) -- a behavior change to 14 wired Naval carriers (none in the pinned Lion/Crane decks), pinned by a test. Rebuilding Kyuden Hida's forced-pass clause (deferred until claims existed) now enforced. General before-resolution window (spec 5): PendingBeforeBattleResolve discovers any in-play card at the battlefield with a BeforeResolution-timed ability (mandatory or optional beforeBattleOptional), ordered by the turn player; Encircled Terrain registered through the same path with its tests unchanged; training-* fixtures prove mandatory, who-fights-changing, optional and two-source ordering. Public MatchView.BattleStep (BattleStepView) for the sidebar #311, optional trailing member, identical for both viewers; QueryActions now offers the previously unlisted beforeBattleOrder/encircledOrder/encircledSelect plus the new windows. BLOCKERS entries naming the Engage window rewritten; ROADMAP Engage row done; decision doc with verbatim rulings, segment-by-segment conformance table and open questions in docs/decisions/2026-09-18-battle-timing-primitives.md. Rebased onto origin/main 7ac0854f (Kakihara + Gold refactor merged); pinned published count recomputed 390 -> 391 from the actual files.
validation: dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Core.Tests: core 200/200, published 57/57, gold-parity 18/18, gold-quote 20/20, battle-timing 21/21 (new), deck-format 9/9, deck-workshop 10/10 (existing Encircled Terrain + multi-source ordering + published-transcript Replay unchanged and passing); bash tools/check.sh --skip-client all green (Python 43 + 130, L5R.AI.Tests 14/14, L5R.Server.Tests 6/6, L5R.Client.Transport.Tests 5/5, incl. a BattleStepView wire round-trip and a reflection check that every member reaches the wire). Two rounds of mutation checks each made the intended test fail (defender-claim precedence, claim stacking, Naval > vs >=, Scout condition, at-battlefield condition, Battle action inside the window, Kyuden Hida, first-action limit not cleared/not enforced, defender-Reconnaissance no-op, window opening with nothing playable, before-resolution order and optional-choice controller). Pinned count 391 verified independently by counting distinct non-ScenarioOnly ids in content/published/*.json. Not tested: a live Godot client with the new legal-action types.
remaining: Open rules questions recorded in the decision doc (defender Reconnaissance, Naval assumptions, Kyuden Hida forced pass, Declaration Segment, first-action-grant negation, before-resolution Reactions/delayed effects). Client (#311): render beforeBattleOptional/beforeBattleOrder/encircledOrder/encircledSelect and read MatchView.BattleStep. PR B (#321, Daidoji Ebizo as personality-wave-26) stacks on this branch.
